behavior.activities: Authoritative merchant onboarding policy is shared by the home editor; canonical businessTypeId is preserved in customer responses and models. Previously published legacy selectors are supported for compatibility.
behavior.classifications: Central classifications may be scoped to canonical activities. Branch, product, and menu-category assignments are separate and checked for branch ownership.
behavior.merchant: Owner can select central classifications in the product and menu-category editor; normal draft, audit, request replay and menu publication remain in effect.
behavior.publication: Effective product and category classifications are frozen in menu version snapshots. A derived publishedCuisineIds field on the business supports home discovery without scanning menus. Rollback restores the aggregate.
behavior.centralAssignments: Central product/category assignments take effect on next merchant menu publication, not by changing prices or draft products.
behavior.filters: Classification strip and section rules match explicit branch assignments or published classified products.

humanChecksPending: Create an activity-compatible central classification and assign to a product and an owned menu category.
Publish the menu, verify the corresponding home filter and confirm draft edits are absent before publication.
Switch branches during taxonomy loading and verify no cross-branch result is applied.
Verify menu rollback restores the previous classification results.
limitations: Legacy published activity selectors are intentionally retained until their authored strip is updated to canonical activity IDs.
Product classification changes from employee device sessions require the branch owner; existing device menu permissions are not expanded.
